nodes.subtreeText: Apollo 11 (July 16–24, 1969) was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon , and the fifth crewed mission of NASA 's Apollo program . The mission was crewed by Commander Neil Armstrong , Command Module Pilot Michael Collins , and Lunar Module Pilot Edwin "Buzz" Aldrin , all of whom were on their second and final spaceflight.
